ui.chat.composer.welcome: What can I help you with today?
ui.chat.composer.delivery_remedies_hint: The message that could not be delivered has Send again and Edit controls in the conversation above this box: press Shift+Tab to reach them.
ui.chat.composer.secret_ask_notice: The agent is asking for a secret. Enter it in the asks panel — you can keep chatting meanwhile.
ui.chat.composer.secret_confirm_message: This looks like a password or key. Where should it go?
ui.chat.composer.secret_fill_locked: Not put in the secret field: a message is still sending. Your text is kept — try again once it lands.
ui.chat.composer.secret_fill_changed: Not put in the secret field: the request changed first. Your text is kept.
ui.chat.composer.secret_fill_gone: Not put in the secret field: that request is no longer waiting. Your text is kept.
ui.chat.composer.secret_fill_refused: The secret field did not take that value. Your text is kept — the asks panel shows why.
ui.chat.composer.secret_fill_unavailable: Could not reach the secret field. Your text is kept.
ui.chat.composer.secret_fill_multi: This request asks for more than one secret. Your text is kept — choose the field in the asks panel.
